_doc: The sea slugs' reference taxonomy from WoRMS (AphiaClassificationByAphiaID; tools/seaslug_worms.py, never hand-edited): nodes {AphiaID: {name, rank, parent}} from the class down, genera {genus name: WoRMS genus AphiaID}. tools/seaslug_game.py writes the game's part into seaslug.json ref (the admin's Photos › Tree › WoRMS view).
cite: WoRMS Editorial Board, World Register of Marine Species, https://www.marinespecies.org (REST web services)
